Base Case (Status Quo).description: Conflict remains in eastern DRC. Kasai region stable. Supply chain intact.

Scenario A \u2014 Moderate Escalation.description: Conflict expands toward Kasai. Intermittent supply disruption. Lead times +60 days.
Scenario A \u2014 Moderate Escalation.recommended_action: Activate diaspora supplier network. Increase safety stock. Reduce new DRC orders by 40%.

Scenario B \u2014 Severe Escalation.description: Conflict reaches Kasai-Central. Supply routes cut. Artisan safety at risk.
Scenario B \u2014 Severe Escalation.recommended_action: Suspend DRC orders. Full pivot to diaspora network. Establish artisan emergency fund.

Scenario C \u2014 Conflict Reaches Kuba.description: Direct conflict in Kasai. Production impossible. Artisan displacement likely.
Scenario C \u2014 Conflict Reaches Kuba.recommended_action: Emergency response. Activate NGO partnerships. Pivot entirely to diaspora + alternative sourcing.
